generic_name: Acetaminophen, Dextromethorphan Hydrobromide, Guaifenesin, and Phenylephrine
brand_names: Mucinex Fast-Max Cold, Flu and Sore Throat
drug_class: Combination cold and flu medication (analgesic, cough suppressant, expectorant, and nasal decongestant)
purpose: This medication is used to relieve multiple cold and flu symptoms all at once. It helps with fever, aches, coughing, chest congestion, and a stuffy nose. Think of it as a one-stop product to make you feel more comfortable when you are sick.
how_it_works: Acetaminophen reduces fever and relieves pain like headaches and body aches. Dextromethorphan works in your brain to calm the urge to cough, while Guaifenesin loosens and thins mucus in your chest so it is easier to cough up. Phenylephrine narrows the blood vessels in your nasal passages to reduce that stuffy, blocked feeling in your nose.
common_side_effects: You may feel drowsy, dizzy, or have an upset stomach. Some people notice nervousness, trouble sleeping, or a faster heartbeat, especially from the decongestant. Nausea is also possible.
warnings: Do not take more than the recommended dose because too much acetaminophen can seriously harm your liver. Avoid taking other products that also contain acetaminophen at the same time. Do not use this if you take MAO inhibitor antidepressants or have taken them in the last 14 days, as this can cause a dangerous reaction. People with high blood pressure, heart disease, thyroid problems, diabetes, or an enlarged prostate should check with their doctor before using this. Avoid alcohol while taking this medication.
typical_dosing: Adults and children 12 years and older typically take one dose every 4 to 6 hours as needed. Always follow the directions on the package label carefully and do not take more than the maximum daily doses listed. Do not give this to children under 12 unless your doctor says it is okay.
